objective: Replace the overstrong need to infer the complete private Opus capability envelope with the minimum sound certificates needed for MysteryMechanism represented-scope intrinsic noninferiority.

actor_attribution.rule: Use 109 as the causally cleaner represented-scope intrinsic comparator. Do not promote 49.10 to a global intrinsic Opus 5.5 ceiling.

definitions.S_O: fallback-excluded intrinsic Opus-success subset of M
definitions.S_B: Brain-success subset of M under the same task contract and scorer

admissible_routes.MATCHED_COUNT: Authentic independently verified Brain receipt on the same 222 private tasks, contract and scorer with at least 109 successes and no opaque target-capability provider.
admissible_routes.THRESHOLD_MASS: Scope-complete proof that at least 109 private tasks belong to a class on which Brain is guaranteed to receive binary credit under the same contract and scorer.
admissible_routes.SUCCESS_SET_DOMINANCE: Content-bound taskwise proof that S_O is a subset of S_B with |S_O|=109.

information_lower_bound.reason: Finite public transcripts without a sound private-mechanism-class restriction admit hidden worlds with identical public evidence and different private success mass.
information_lower_bound.required_new_information_if_no_matched_r: A sound private-population mass relation or success-set relation.

implementation.policy: Fail closed on population, contract, scorer, receipt or independence mismatch.

hard_nonclaims: No claim Brain currently has 109 private successes.
No claim a current public symbolic grammar covers 109 private tasks.
No claim 49.10 is a global intrinsic Opus 5.5 ceiling.
No claim the global Opus unknown-mechanism capability envelope is identified.
No acceptance, family, capability, ownership or terminal credit.
